name: WowShipping
author: WPXPO

sections.description:
Table Rate Shipping is a powerful and flexible shipping method that allows store owners to define shipping costs based on a wide range of conditions. This feature enables you to create highly customizable shipping rules tailored to your business needs and customer expectations.

With Table Rate Shipping, you can set shipping rates based on:
✅ Destination: Country, state, region, or postal code
✅ Order Subtotal: Apply rates based on the total value of the cart
✅ Weight: Calculate shipping costs depending on the total weight of the order
✅ Item quantity: Set different rates based on the number of items in the cart
✅ Shipping class or product category: Charge differently for different types of products

This method is ideal for businesses with complex shipping requirements or those looking to offer more accurate and competitive rates to customers. Whether you’re shipping locally or internationally, Table Rate Shipping helps optimize your logistics strategy and improve the overall customer experience.

Author

Developed by WPXPO. Contribute to WowShipping on Bitbucket and join the party.

Privacy & Data Usage

This plugin uses IPInfo to determine the user’s country only for analytics purposes. The request is made only after the user gives consent (e.g., admin notice banner, plugin deactivation survey). Only the country code is logged for analytics.
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0.0 or greater
  • PHP version 7.3 or greater
  • MySQL version 5.6 or greater

Automatic installation

Automatic installation is the easiest option as WordPress handles the file transfers itself and you don’t even need to leave your web browser.

  1. Go to your WordPress Plugin installation menu (Dashboard > Plugins > Add New)
  2. In the search field type “WowShipping” and press enter.
  3. “Install Now” and then click “Active”

Manual installation

For Manual installation, you download our product from WordPress directory uploading it to your web-server via your FTP or CPanel application.

  1. Download the plugin and unzip it
  2. Using an FTP program or CPanel upload the unzipped plugin folder to your WordPress installation’s wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  3. Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu (Dashboard > Plugins > Installed Plugins) within the WordPress admin.

Upgrading

Automatic update working great for this plugin. If you customize the plugin make sure to store a backup before update.

Sometimes because of the permalink issue during the plugin update, just go to WordPress > Settings > Permalinks and hit the ‘Save’ button.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0 – 17 Nov 2025

  • New: Major UI overhaul for better user experience in the rules builder page
  • New: Added display rules for individual shipping methods
  • New: Improved flexible shipping rate calculation engine

1.0.7 – 30 Oct 2025

  • Fix: Cart Total condition not working as expected
  • Fix: Product criteria not applying correctly in some cases

1.0.6 – 20 Oct 2025

  • New: New condition based on Coupon code
  • New: New condition based on Weekday and Time

1.0.5 – 14 Oct 2025

  • New: Added live rate support Sendle and Australia Post (beta)
  • New: Added zip/post code condition
  • Update: Removed unused dependencies
  • Fix: Some strings were not being translated
  • Fix: Shipping class condition not working

1.0.4 – 15 Sep 2025

  • Fixed shipping rate calculation errors when using weight-based conditions
